interpretation.direction: First minus second; negative favors the first configuration.
interpretation.regret: At the identical fixed-data prefix, the common comparator cancels exactly.
interpretation.numerics: Differences use recorded float64 cumulative losses; no optimization or statistical estimate is substituted.
interpretation.zeros: Missing or zero-round runs have unavailable comparisons, never imputed zero loss.
interpretation.seeds: Descriptive paired datasets only; no confidence intervals or significance claims.
interpretation.different_prefixes: Pair-common summaries may average different attained horizons across seeds; use fixed checkpoints for identical horizons.
interpretation.time: Cumulative measured online time at the prefix, including initialization; not full process wall time.
